verdicts.reason: A has no collisions and a clear headline, but the order is jumbled: the CTA sits at the top of the right-hand stack above the pills and badge, and the body copy ends up at the bottom right. The CTA is also about the same size as the pills, so it doesn't stand out, and the body copy is cramped and tiny. B keeps the right reading order, but its layout is broken: the circle runs under 'GROVE' and the headline, it is cropped at the top-left, and the product is pushed against the left edge, shrunk. The pills, badge and CTA sit on different, ragged axes.
